detail.title: The Importance of Teachers and Socioeconomic Background for Students at Risk of Dyslexia

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Approximately 7-10% of the population have some degree of dyslexia, and students with this disability are likely to be more dependent on qualified teaching. I analyze this tenet using population-wide Danish administrative records of public schools, where subject teachers are linked over time to classrooms and students, and identification is achieved using a within-school between-class model. I find that qualified teachers improve student outcomes mostly at the bottom of the student skill distribution and that students tested as at-risk of dyslexia in 4th grade make smaller progress in 6th grade vis-à-vis their peers, except for at-risk students from high SES schools who catch up with their peers. Unqualified teaching in combination with low SES schools impedes the ability of dyslexicstudents to reach their potential, and upholds the inter-generational correlation in education.

AI.tldr: 研究丹麦公立学校数据发现，合格教师主要提升技能分布底端学生的成绩，有阅读障碍风险的学生在6年级进步较小，但高社会经济地位学校的风险学生能追上同龄人。不合格教学与低社会经济地位学校结合会阻碍阅读障碍学生发挥潜力，维持教育代际相关性。
AI.research_question: 合格教师对有阅读障碍风险的学生学业表现有何影响？这种影响在不同社会经济地位学校中是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 约7-10%人口有不同程度阅读障碍，这些学生可能更依赖合格教师。研究合格教师对阅读障碍学生的影响，特别是结合学校社会经济背景的交互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育不平等理论、教师质量对学生成绩影响理论、社会经济地位与教育成就的代际传递理论、特殊教育需求学生的支持理论。
AI.method: 使用丹麦全国行政记录，追踪公立学校学科教师与班级、学生的关联，采用校内班级间模型进行识别分析。
AI.findings: 1. 合格教师主要提升技能分布底端学生的成绩；2. 4年级被检测有阅读障碍风险的学生在6年级进步较小；3. 高社会经济地位学校的风险学生能追上同龄人；4. 不合格教学与低社会经济地位学校结合阻碍阅读障碍学生发挥潜力；5. 维持教育代际相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示教师质量对不同能力学生影响的异质性；2. 阐明社会经济地位在特殊教育需求学生支持中的调节作用；3. 为教育不平等理论提供实证证据，特别是代际传递机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供针对性教师分配建议；2. 强调低社会经济地位学校需要更多合格教师支持特殊需求学生；3. 为阅读障碍学生干预策略提供实证依据；4. 有助于打破教育代际不平等。

title: A Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Cognitive Load Detection using Single Lead EEG, CiSSA and Nature-Inspired Feature Selection
affiliations: IES College of Technology, CGI Business Consulting, K R Mangalam University, RK University, Rajkot, MLR Institute of Technology and CMR Engineering College

detail.title: A Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Cognitive Load Detection using Single Lead EEG, CiSSA and Nature-Inspired Feature Selection
detail.abstract: Decomposition of EEG data into IMFs was performed using CiSSA. During the second phase, IMFs investigated characteristics that were based on entropy. The characteristics obtained were then used to examine categories by feeding them into nature-inspired algorithms for selection of features (GA, BPSO, PSO, BBA, and BDA) that were trained using machine learning methods (KNN and SVM). Understanding, focus, mental agility, and the capacity to make decisions are all required for an assortment of jobs. On the other hand, the ability of human brains to comprehend and integrate information is restricted. The cognitive "load" refers to the amount of work that these limited capabilities have to do. The dynamics of the brain are significantly altered when cognitive stress is present, as indicated by neurobiology. Changes in cognitive workload patterns are possible. in accordance with characteristics related to stress, anxiety, or mental health, such as breathing, heart rate variability, and skin in addition to blood pressure and conductivity. Outperforming models such as Bat Optimization with K-Nearest Neighbours (BO-KNN), Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT), KNN, and Support Vector Machine (SVM), the suggested method-which combines Circulant Singular Spectrum Analysis (Ci-SSA), Binary Dragonfly Algorithm (BDA), and K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN)-achieves an astounding accuracy of 99.74%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合CiSSA、BDA和KNN的认知负荷检测方法，在EEG数据分析中达到了99.74%的惊人准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过脑电图(EEG)数据分析准确检测和分类认知负荷水平？
AI.motivation: 人类大脑的信息处理能力有限，认知负荷会影响工作表现和决策能力。现有的认知负荷检测方法准确率有待提高，需要开发更有效的分析方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知负荷理论、神经生物学（大脑动态变化）、熵理论（信息复杂度测量）、特征选择理论（自然启发算法）
AI.method: 采用CiSSA分解EEG数据为IMF分量，基于熵提取特征，使用自然启发算法（GA、BPSO、PSO、BBA、BDA）进行特征选择，最后用KNN和SVM进行分类。
AI.findings: 提出的CiSSA-BDA-KNN组合方法达到了99.74%的准确率，显著优于BO-KNN、SWT、KNN和SVM等现有模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将CiSSA与自然启发算法结合用于EEG信号分析；2. 验证了熵特征在认知负荷检测中的有效性；3. 建立了高效的认知负荷分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供高精度的认知负荷检测工具；2. 可用于工作场所人因工程评估；3. 为心理健康监测和压力管理提供技术支持；4. 在教育和培训中优化认知负荷分配。

reference: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 827
title: Digital Trade Facilitation and Container Traffic: Evidence from the Electronic Single Window Rollout in the People’s Republic of China
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE), Paris School of Economics (PSE), Paris School of Economics (PSE) and University College Dublin

detail.title: Digital Trade Facilitation and Container Traffic: Evidence from the Electronic Single Window Rollout in the People’s Republic of China

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 827
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence linking digital trade facilitation reforms to changes in port operations. Leveraging the staggered rollout of Single Window reforms in the People’s Republic of China (2014–2016), which streamlined customs clearance, we combine Automatic Identification System data on container ship movements with event study methods to identify causal effects. While effects on carried tonnage are positive but statistically insignificant, decomposition analysis reveals that the Single Window operates through a specific channel, without changing vessel loading conditions, ship size, and port processing times. To assess port responses, we analyze heterogeneity across vessel and terminal characteristics. Impacts are concentrated among smaller vessels and less congested terminals, with no effect on larger vessels and capacity-constrained facilities. These findings demonstrate that administrative efficiency improvements boost maritime activity through extensive rather than intensive margins, with ports accommodating increased trade demand primarily through higher vessel frequency.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次提供了数字贸易便利化改革对港口运营影响的实证证据。利用中国单一窗口改革（2014-2016年）的渐进实施，结合船舶自动识别系统数据和事件研究方法，发现改革通过特定渠道提升海运活动，主要影响小型船舶和非拥堵码头，通过增加船舶频率而非改变装载条件或处理时间来促进贸易。
AI.research_question: 数字贸易便利化改革（特别是单一窗口改革）如何影响港口运营和海运活动？改革通过哪些具体渠道发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 虽然数字贸易便利化改革被广泛推广，但缺乏关于其对港口运营实际影响的实证证据。了解这些改革如何影响海运活动对政策制定和港口管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易便利化理论、港口运营效率理论、边际调整理论（集约边际vs扩展边际）
AI.method: 利用中国单一窗口改革（2014-2016年）的渐进实施作为准自然实验，结合船舶自动识别系统（AIS）数据，采用事件研究方法识别因果关系。进行分解分析以识别具体作用渠道，并分析船舶和码头特征的异质性。
AI.findings: 1. 总吨位影响为正但不显著；2. 单一窗口通过特定渠道运作，不改变船舶装载条件、船舶大小和港口处理时间；3. 影响集中在小型船舶和较少拥堵的码头；4. 对大型船舶和容量受限设施无影响；5. 行政效率提升主要通过扩展边际（增加船舶频率）而非集约边际来促进海运活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供数字贸易便利化改革对港口运营影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了改革通过扩展边际而非集约边际运作的机制；3. 为贸易便利化理论提供了微观层面的实证支持；4. 丰富了港口运营效率的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改革效果评估的实证依据；2. 帮助港口管理者了解改革对不同类型船舶和码头的影响差异；3. 为投资决策提供参考，特别是对小型船舶和非拥堵码头的运营优化；4. 强调了通过提高行政效率来增加贸易流量的重要性。

title: Do Advisors’ Status and Identity Shape Adherence to Advice?
affiliations: Monash University, Monash University - Department of Economics, Gothenburg University,  and GATE - CNRS

detail.title: Do Advisors’ Status and Identity Shape Adherence to Advice?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines whether adherence to advice depends on an advisor’s identity and status beyond message content. Using a survey experiment with over 3000 farmers in India, we find that individuals are more likely to follow advice in a social dilemma game when it comes from high-status or in-group advisors, even when the advice diverges from prevailing norms. Admired role models can attenuate the influence of status and identity, though their beneficial effect is not universal. Our experimental findings align with evidence from an agricultural advisory program involving the same participant sample, highlighting the broader real-world relevance of these patterns.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过印度3000多名农民的调查实验发现，人们更倾向于遵循来自高地位或内群体顾问的建议，即使这些建议与主流规范相悖。受尊敬的角色榜样可以减弱地位和身份的影响，但其有益效果并非普遍适用。
AI.research_question: 在建议采纳过程中，顾问的身份和地位（超出建议内容本身）是否会影响人们遵循建议的意愿？
AI.motivation: 理解社会困境中建议采纳的机制，特别是身份和地位因素如何影响决策，这对于设计有效的建议传递系统（如农业推广项目）具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认同理论、地位理论、社会影响理论、角色榜样理论
AI.method: 采用调查实验方法，对印度3000多名农民进行社会困境游戏实验，并结合实际农业咨询项目的证据进行验证。
AI.findings:
1. 人们更可能遵循来自高地位或内群体顾问的建议，即使这些建议偏离主流规范
2. 受尊敬的角色榜样可以减弱地位和身份的影响
3. 角色榜样的有益效果并非普遍适用
4. 实验结果与实际农业咨询项目的观察结果一致
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了建议采纳理论，强调了身份和地位因素的重要性
2. 揭示了角色榜样在调节社会影响过程中的复杂作用
3. 为社会困境中的决策研究提供了新的视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为农业推广项目和其他建议传递系统的设计提供指导
2. 帮助政策制定者更有效地选择和建议传递者
3. 为组织中的领导力和影响力管理提供实践启示

title: An Economist’s Ode to the Forests and the Sea
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: An Economist’s Ode to the Forests and the Sea

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The field of economics ought to be based on the fact that planet Earth is a rare Earth that is fundamentally an Ocean and Plant World. The rapid and continuing bulldozing of biodiversity across ocean and land that has been a feature of human society’s economic development over the past two centuries or so, demonstrates that the current political and economic response, framed by the narrow human-centric concept of sustainable development, has failed. Therefore, this paper calls for a fundamental planetary turn in perspective, moving beyond sustainability towards the biocentric concept of Planetary Habitability. The point is that fixing a slow leak in a spaceship (sustainability) is insufficient when the ship’s entire life support system is collapsing due to a fundamental design flaw (anthropocentrism); instead, the focus must shift to ensuring the entire ship can support life (habitability), regardless of immediate human convenience.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判当前以人类为中心的可持续发展理念失败，主张从可持续性转向行星宜居性的生物中心视角，将地球视为海洋与植物世界来重构经济学基础。
AI.research_question: 如何超越人类中心的可持续发展框架，建立基于行星宜居性的生物中心经济学范式？
AI.motivation: 过去两个世纪人类经济发展导致海洋和陆地生物多样性快速丧失，当前以人类为中心的可持续发展理念已失败，需要根本性的视角转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行星宜居性理论、生物中心主义、生态经济学、地球系统科学，批判人类中心主义的可持续发展框架。
AI.method: 概念分析、理论构建、批判性论述，通过类比（宇宙飞船生命支持系统）阐述从可持续性到宜居性的范式转变。
AI.findings: 可持续性框架如同修补宇宙飞船的缓慢泄漏，而根本问题是飞船生命支持系统因设计缺陷（人类中心主义）而崩溃；必须转向确保整个飞船能支持生命的宜居性视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出行星宜居性作为可持续发展范式的替代，建立生物中心的经济学理论基础，将地球视为海洋与植物世界的稀有行星。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、经济学家和环保实践者提供新的行动框架，推动从人类便利导向转向生态系统完整性导向的经济决策。

title: Can the Keyboard Beat the Good Old Pen? Computer-Based Testing and Students’ Performance
affiliations: Nova School of Business and Economics, Nova School of Business and Economics, Nova School of Business and Economics and University of Lisbon - ISEG School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Can the Keyboard Beat the Good Old Pen? Computer-Based Testing and Students’ Performance

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Computer-based testing is increasingly being adopted by educational institutions worldwide. However, whether this transition from paper-based testing leads to different outcomes in student performance remains an open question. This paper assesses the impact of computer-based testing by examining a large-scale pilot programme for low-stakes exams implemented in Portugal in 2022. We leverage rich student-level data to implement pooled OLS and difference-in-differences approaches. Our results indicate that students who used computer-based testing performed worse than their peers using paper-based testing by 5 to 14 percentage points, on average. This negative effect is concentrated in specific question formats, namely questions requiring the analysis of figures. We discuss the implications of our findings for the large-scale implementation of computer-based testing.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过葡萄牙2022年大规模试点项目，发现计算机化考试导致学生成绩比纸质考试低5-14个百分点，特别是需要分析图表的问题类型受影响最大。
AI.research_question: 从纸质考试向计算机化考试过渡是否会导致学生成绩差异？计算机化考试对学生表现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 全球教育机构越来越多采用计算机化考试，但这种转变是否会影响学生成绩仍是一个未解决的问题，需要实证研究来指导政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育评估技术、考试媒介效应理论，以及数字鸿沟相关理论框架，探讨技术工具如何影响评估结果。
AI.method: 利用葡萄牙2022年大规模试点项目的丰富学生层面数据，采用混合OLS和双重差分法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 使用计算机化考试的学生平均成绩比使用纸质考试的学生低5-14个百分点；负面影响主要集中在需要分析图表的具体问题类型上。
AI.theory_contributions: 为考试媒介效应理论提供实证支持，揭示计算机化考试对不同类型问题的差异化影响，丰富了教育技术评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构大规模实施计算机化考试提供重要参考，建议关注特定问题类型的适应性调整，优化考试设计以减少技术媒介的负面影响。

title: Economic Consequences of Political Persecution (updated research)
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - CERGE-EI, a joint workplace of Charles University and the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences and Centre for Economic Analysis (CenEA)

detail.title: Economic Consequences of Political Persecution (updated research)

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the consequences of political persecution under the communist regime on labor market outcomes using life history data from the Czech sample of the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe. The risk of persecution is instrumented using unique administrative data on the intensity of political oppression. We find strong evidence of career degradation as a consequence of persecution-driven job losses. Our estimates suggest that earnings in jobs following such a loss carried a penalty of over 60 percent that accumulated over time to substantially lower retirement benefits. We document the gravity of economic consequences for ordinary citizens persecuted by the authoritarian regime as well as effective compensating schemes implemented by democratic governments after 1989.

AI.tldr: 研究使用捷克SHARE数据，通过政治压迫强度作为工具变量，发现政治迫害导致工作流失和职业降级，造成超过60%的收入惩罚，并显著降低退休福利，同时记录了民主政府补偿方案的有效性。
AI.research_question: 共产主义政权下的政治迫害对劳动力市场结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解威权政权政治迫害对普通公民长期经济后果的严重性，以及民主政府补偿方案的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、劳动力市场理论、人力资本理论、制度变迁理论。
AI.method: 使用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）捷克样本的生命史数据，以政治压迫强度作为工具变量进行因果推断分析。
AI.findings: 政治迫害导致职业降级和工作流失，后续工作收入惩罚超过60%，随时间累积显著降低退休福利；民主政府补偿方案有效缓解了这些负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政治迫害对人力资本和劳动力市场结果的长期影响提供因果证据，扩展了制度变迁与个人经济后果的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了政治迫害的经济成本，为政策制定者设计补偿方案提供实证依据，帮助理解威权政权转型后的社会修复机制。

title: Information Acquisition By Mutual Fund Investors: Evidence from Stock Trading Suspensions
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business and

detail.title: Information Acquisition By Mutual Fund Investors: Evidence from Stock Trading Suspensions

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Mutual funds create liquidity for investors by issuing demandable equity shares while holding illiquid securities. We study the implications of this liquidity creation by examining frequent trading suspensions in China, which temporarily eliminate market liquidity in affected stocks. These suspensions cause significant mispricing of mutual funds due to inaccurate valuations of their illiquid holdings. We find that investors actively acquire information about suspended stocks held by mutual funds, driving flows into underpriced funds. This information is subsequently incorporated into stock prices when trading resumes. Our findings suggest that mutual fund liquidity creation stimulates information acquisition about illiquid, information-sensitive assets.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析中国股市频繁的停牌现象，探讨了共同基金在发行可赎回份额同时持有非流动性证券这一流动性创造行为的影响。研究发现，停牌导致基金持有的非流动性资产估值不准确，引发基金定价偏差，而投资者会主动获取停牌股票信息，推动资金流向被低估的基金，这些信息在股票恢复交易后被纳入股价。
AI.research_question: 共同基金通过发行可赎回份额同时持有非流动性证券来创造流动性，这种流动性创造行为对市场信息获取和资产定价有何影响？
AI.motivation: 共同基金面临一个根本性矛盾：为投资者提供流动性（允许随时赎回份额），同时投资于流动性较差的证券。中国股市频繁的停牌现象为研究这种流动性创造行为的影响提供了独特环境，因为停牌暂时消除了受影响股票的市场流动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流动性创造理论、信息获取理论和资产定价理论，研究共同基金在流动性转换中的作用，以及市场参与者如何应对非流动性资产估值不准确的情况。
AI.method: 利用中国股市频繁的停牌事件作为自然实验，分析停牌期间共同基金持有的非流动性证券估值不准确如何影响基金定价，并追踪投资者信息获取行为、资金流向以及股票恢复交易后的价格调整。
AI.findings: 1. 停牌导致共同基金持有的非流动性证券估值不准确，引发基金显著定价偏差；2. 投资者会主动获取关于停牌股票的信息，推动资金流向被低估的基金；3. 这些信息在股票恢复交易后被纳入股价；4. 共同基金的流动性创造功能刺激了市场对非流动性、信息敏感资产的信息获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对共同基金流动性创造功能的理解，特别是其在信息获取中的作用；2. 揭示了非流动性资产估值不准确如何影响基金定价和投资者行为；3. 为流动性转换和信息获取之间的相互作用提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为基金投资者提供了在停牌等流动性事件中的投资策略参考；2. 为监管机构理解市场流动性创造机制和风险提供了实证依据；3. 为基金管理公司应对非流动性资产估值挑战提供了管理启示。

title: Intergenerational Educational Mobility Among Immigrants and Descendants in Denmark: The Role of Sample Selectivity and Data Quality
affiliations: Rockwool Foundation Research Unit and University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Intergenerational Educational Mobility Among Immigrants and Descendants in Denmark: The Role of Sample Selectivity and Data Quality

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies intergenerational educational mobility among immigrants and descendants in Denmark for cohorts born between 1965 and 1990. At first glance, the data suggests that immigrants experience higher mobility than native Danes, but this pattern is driven by low coverage and poor data quality of parental education information in administrative registers. Among immigrants with the most reliable data, mobility patterns closely resemble those of natives. Auxiliary analyses using representative survey data corroborate this finding. Moreover, including immigrants in population-wide mobility estimates—given their artificially high relative mobility—attenuates trends in estimated mobility, especially for cohorts bornin the 1980s.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，丹麦移民的代际教育流动性表面上高于本地丹麦人，但这主要是由于行政登记中父母教育信息的覆盖不足和数据质量问题造成的。在数据最可靠的移民群体中，其流动性模式与本地人相似。
AI.research_question: 丹麦移民及其后代的代际教育流动性模式是怎样的？移民的高流动性观察结果是否真实反映了社会流动性，还是数据质量问题造成的假象？
AI.motivation: 理解移民群体的代际教育流动性对于评估社会公平和移民融合政策至关重要。先前研究表明移民流动性高于本地人，但可能存在数据质量问题影响结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际教育流动性理论、移民融合理论、社会分层理论、数据质量对社会科学研究的影响
AI.method: 使用丹麦1965-1990年出生队列的行政登记数据，结合代表性调查数据进行辅助分析，比较移民与本地丹麦人的代际教育流动性
AI.findings: 1. 表面数据显示移民流动性高于本地丹麦人；2. 但这是由于行政登记中父母教育信息的覆盖不足和数据质量问题造成的；3. 在数据最可靠的移民群体中，流动性模式与本地人相似；4. 将移民纳入总体流动性估计会削弱流动性趋势，特别是1980年代出生队列
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了数据质量问题如何扭曲移民流动性的观察结果；2. 挑战了移民具有更高代际流动性的普遍假设；3. 强调了在移民研究中考虑数据质量的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者注意行政数据在移民研究中的局限性；2. 为更准确地评估移民融合政策提供方法论指导；3. 建议改进移民数据的收集和质量控制

title: Marijuana Legalization and Suicides Among Older Adults
affiliations: Emory University and

detail.title: Marijuana Legalization and Suicides Among Older Adults

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Suicide rates among older adults have been rising over time in the United States. At the same time, more individuals have been suffering with chronic pain and illness, which are often underlying risk factors for suicide. As self-medication with marijuana has become common, we ask whether access to legal marijuana for medical and recreational purposes reduces suicides rates among older individuals. We find that suicide rates among older age groups decline following the opening of recreational marijuana dispensaries, especially among older Whites, and middle-aged White males and females with low levels of education.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，娱乐性大麻药房开放后，老年人群的自杀率下降，特别是白人老年群体以及教育程度较低的中年白人男性和女性。
AI.research_question: 合法大麻（医疗和娱乐用途）的获取是否会降低老年人的自杀率？
AI.motivation: 美国老年人自杀率持续上升，同时慢性疼痛和疾病患者增多，这些都是自杀的风险因素。随着大麻自我治疗变得普遍，研究大麻合法化对老年人自杀率的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于慢性疼痛和疾病作为自杀风险因素的理论框架，以及大麻可能通过缓解疼痛和改善心理健康来降低自杀风险的假设。
AI.method: 使用美国各州大麻合法化政策变化的数据，分析娱乐性大麻药房开放前后老年人自杀率的变化，特别关注不同人口亚组（种族、性别、教育程度）的差异。
AI.findings: 娱乐性大麻药房开放后，老年人群的自杀率下降，这一效应在老年白人群体中尤为明显，同时教育程度较低的中年白人男性和女性的自杀率也显著降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解大麻政策对公共健康（特别是心理健康和自杀预防）的影响提供了新的理论视角，扩展了关于物质使用与自杀风险关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大麻政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明娱乐性大麻合法化可能有助于降低特定人群的自杀风险，对公共卫生政策和自杀预防策略具有参考价值。

title: The Effects of Widespread Online Education on Market Structure and Enrollment
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, Georgetown University and Columbia University

detail.title: The Effects of Widespread Online Education on Market Structure and Enrollment

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study the rapid expansion of Brazil's private online higher-education sector and its effects on market structure and college enrollment. Exploiting regional and field-specific variation in online education penetration, we find that online programs expand access for older students but divert younger students from higher-quality in-person programs. Greater competition lowers tuition prices but also reduces the supply of in-person degrees. Using an equilibrium model of college education, we show that in the absence of online programs, total enrollment would be 14 percent lower, while in-person enrollment would rise by 33 percent. On net, aggregate labor-market value added declines by 1.4 percent. Online education raises value added for older students, who benefit from increased access, but lowers it for younger students, who shift toward lower-return online options. Counterfactual policies that restrict online enrollment to older cohorts could increase value added for younger students without reducing gains for older cohorts.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究巴西私立在线高等教育快速扩张对市场结构和大学入学的影响。在线教育扩大了年长学生的入学机会，但将年轻学生从质量更高的线下课程分流出去。竞争降低了学费，但也减少了线下学位供给。模拟显示，没有在线教育时总入学率会低14%，线下入学率会高33%。总体劳动力市场增加值下降1.4%，年长学生获益而年轻学生受损。
AI.research_question: 巴西私立在线高等教育的快速扩张如何影响高等教育市场结构和大学入学？在线教育对不同年龄段学生的教育机会和劳动力市场价值有何异质性影响？
AI.motivation: 在线高等教育在全球范围内快速增长，特别是在发展中国家。巴西私立在线高等教育部门迅速扩张，但对其市场结构效应、对不同年龄段学生的影响以及总体劳动力市场价值的影响缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高等教育市场结构理论、教育经济学、人力资本理论、竞争与市场均衡理论、教育质量与劳动力市场回报关系理论。
AI.method: 利用区域和学科领域在线教育渗透率的变异进行实证分析，建立大学教育均衡模型进行反事实模拟，比较有/无在线教育情境下的入学率、学费和劳动力市场价值。
AI.findings: 1. 在线教育扩大了年长学生的入学机会，但将年轻学生从质量更高的线下课程分流出去；2. 竞争降低了学费，但减少了线下学位供给；3. 没有在线教育时总入学率会低14%，线下入学率会高33%；4. 总体劳动力市场增加值下降1.4%；5. 年长学生从在线教育中获益（价值增加），年轻学生受损（转向回报较低的在线选项）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为在线高等教育对市场结构的异质性影响提供了理论框架；2. 揭示了在线教育对不同年龄段学生的差异化影响机制；3. 拓展了教育竞争与质量权衡的理论理解；4. 为教育政策设计提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策启示：限制年轻学生在线入学可能提高其劳动力市场价值，同时不损害年长学生的获益；2. 为高等教育机构提供市场定位参考；3. 为发展中国家在线教育政策制定提供实证依据；4. 帮助理解在线教育扩张的长期劳动力市场影响。

title: The Economic Legacy of Racial Trauma in the American South
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh - Graduate School of Public & International Affairs and University of Pittsburgh - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Economic Legacy of Racial Trauma in the American South

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
How does the trauma associated with exposure to racial violence affect economic outcomes? We study this question in the context of lynchings of Black citizens in the American South between 1880 and 1940 and provide systematic evidence of long-run economic impacts of that violence for the broader community and the effects’ persistence across generations. First, using data on averted lynchings and matched placebos as counterfactuals, we show that children indirectly exposed to the racial trauma of lynchings (proxied by close proximity to the victim’s household location) exhibit a reduction in occupational income score and likelihood of holding a white collar occupation, in their prime earning years as adults. We also observe intergenerational effects: children of the individuals who were exposed (as children) to lynchings see, as adults observed in 1940, a reduction in their income relative to counterfactual individuals. By documenting long-run and intergenerational economic effects of exposure to lynchings, we add empirical evidence to an interdisciplinary literature that identifies racial trauma as a distinctive and durable form of psychological harm.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究美国南方1880-1940年间黑人私刑的种族创伤如何影响长期经济结果，发现间接暴露于私刑的儿童成年后职业收入和职位等级下降，且这种影响会跨代传递。
AI.research_question: 种族暴力相关的创伤如何影响经济结果？具体研究美国南方1880-1940年间黑人私刑的长期经济影响及其跨代持续性。
AI.motivation: 种族创伤作为一种独特的持久心理伤害，其长期经济后果缺乏系统性实证证据。研究填补了这一空白，为理解种族暴力的代际影响提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 种族创伤理论、代际传递理论、历史创伤对经济发展的长期影响理论。
AI.method: 使用双重差分法，以未发生的私刑（averted lynchings）和匹配的安慰剂作为反事实对照，分析间接暴露于私刑的儿童（以接近受害者家庭位置为代理）的长期经济结果。
AI.findings: 1. 间接暴露于私刑的儿童在成年黄金工作年龄时，职业收入评分和白领职业可能性显著下降；2. 这种影响具有代际传递性：暴露者的子女在1940年观察到的收入也低于反事实对照组。
AI.theory_contributions: 为种族创伤理论提供实证支持，证明种族暴力创伤具有独特性和持久性；扩展了代际传递理论在种族创伤领域的应用；丰富了历史创伤对经济发展长期影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供种族暴力长期经济成本的量化证据；帮助理解当代种族经济差距的历史根源；为赔偿政策和干预措施提供实证依据。

title: "Captain Gains" on Capitol Hill
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU)

detail.title: "Captain Gains" on Capitol Hill

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Using transaction-level data on US congressional stock trades, we find that lawmakers who later ascend to leadership positions perform similarly to matched peers beforehand but outperform them by 47 percentage points annually after ascension. Leaders’ superior performance arises through two mechanisms. The political influence channel is reflected in higher returns when their party controls the chamber, sales of stocks preceding regulatory actions, and purchase of stocks whose firms receiving more government contracts and favorable party support on bills. The corporate access channel is reflected in stock trades that predict subsequent corporate news and greater returns on donor-owned or home-state firms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国国会议员在晋升为领导职位后，其股票交易表现显著优于同行，年化超额收益达47个百分点，主要源于政治影响和企业接触两个渠道
AI.research_question: 国会议员晋升为领导职位后，其股票交易表现是否显著优于同行？如果是，这种超额收益的来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究政治权力与金融市场表现之间的关系，特别是政治领导人的内幕信息优势如何转化为投资回报，对于理解政治腐败和市场公平性具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学和信息不对称理论，探讨政治权力如何通过政治影响渠道（监管、政府合同、法案支持）和企业接触渠道（内幕信息、捐赠者关系）影响投资决策
AI.method: 使用美国国会议员股票交易数据，采用匹配方法比较晋升为领导职位的议员与同行的交易表现，通过事件研究法分析交易时机与政治事件、企业新闻的关系
AI.findings: 1. 议员晋升领导职位后年化超额收益达47个百分点；2. 政治影响渠道：政党控制议院时收益更高，在监管行动前卖出股票，购买获得更多政府合同和法案支持的股票；3. 企业接触渠道：交易能预测企业新闻，在捐赠者或本州企业股票上获得更高回报
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统识别了政治权力转化为金融收益的两个具体机制；2. 丰富了政治经济学中关于权力寻租的理论框架；3. 为信息不对称理论在政治领域的应用提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构制定更严格的政治人物交易规则提供依据；2. 提高公众对政治腐败潜在形式的认识；3. 为投资者理解政治风险与机会提供参考

title: The Market for Voluntary Carbon Offsets
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, VU University Amsterdam, , VU University Amsterdam,  and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics

detail.title: The Market for Voluntary Carbon Offsets
detail.abstract: We study pricing in the voluntary carbon market (VCM) using a novel proprietary dataset of sales of emission reduction certificates (credits) by a leading VCM dealer. We document extraordinary price dispersion, with carbon credits trading between a few cents and $100 per ton of CO2. Prices are systematically related to the credit project, buyer, and trade characteristics, rather than to a common value of carbon emissions. Credits from the least reliable emission reduction technologies, but with positive non-carbon externalities, are twice as expensive as trusted industrial solutions. Buyers in low-emission industries, wealthier countries, and large firms pay a premium for carbon credits, while heavy polluters and firms with explicit sustainability commitments do not. VCM pricing also features volume and client relationship discounts typical for over-the-counter markets. Finally, we document a causal link between the introduction of the VCM futures market and price premia for credits eligible for expiring futures settlement.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用自愿碳市场领先交易商的专有数据，揭示了碳信用价格的极端分散现象（每吨0.01-100美元），发现价格主要受项目特征、买方特征和交易特征影响，而非碳排放的公共价值。不可靠但具有正外部性的减排技术信用价格是可靠工业解决方案的两倍；低排放行业、富裕国家和大型企业支付溢价，而重污染企业和有明确可持续发展承诺的企业则不支付溢价。研究还发现场外市场典型的量和客户关系折扣，以及期货市场引入对合格信用价格溢价的因果影响。
AI.research_question: 自愿碳市场中碳信用价格的决定因素是什么？价格如何随项目特征、买方特征和交易特征而变化？期货市场的引入如何影响碳信用定价？
AI.motivation: 自愿碳市场作为应对气候变化的重要机制，其定价机制尚不清晰。现有研究缺乏对实际交易数据的分析，无法解释观察到的极端价格分散现象。理解价格形成机制对市场效率、环境政策和企业碳抵消策略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论、信息不对称理论、企业社会责任理论，以及场外市场定价理论。研究探讨了碳信用作为异质性商品的价值构成，包括环境效益、非碳外部性、认证质量等维度。
AI.method: 使用领先VCM交易商的专有交易数据集，包含详细的信用项目特征、买方信息和交易条款。采用计量经济学方法分析价格决定因素，包括回归分析和因果推断方法（如期货市场引入的自然实验）。
AI.findings: 1. 碳信用价格极端分散（0.01-100美元/吨）；2. 价格主要由项目、买方和交易特征决定，而非碳排放的公共价值；3. 不可靠但具正外部性的技术信用价格是可靠工业解决方案的两倍；4. 低排放行业、富裕国家、大型企业支付溢价，重污染企业和有明确可持续发展承诺的企业不支付溢价；5. 存在典型的场外市场折扣（量大、长期客户）；6. 期货市场引入对合格信用产生价格溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统揭示了VCM价格形成的微观机制；2. 提出了碳信用作为异质性商品的定价理论框架；3. 扩展了企业社会责任和环境经济学理论；4. 为场外市场定价理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为碳信用买卖双方提供定价参考；2. 为市场监管者提供政策建议；3. 帮助企业制定更有效的碳抵消策略；4. 为投资者提供市场参与指导；5. 为期货市场设计提供实证依据。

title: Fifth Time Lucky? Raila Odinga Targets Triumph in Kenya Presidential Elections
affiliations: University of South Africa (UNISA)

detail.title: Fifth Time Lucky? Raila Odinga Targets Triumph in Kenya Presidential Elections
detail.abstract: Kenyans go to the polls on Tuesday, where veteran opposition politician and serial loser Raila Odinga, 77, faces off against vice president William Ruto, 55. Kenya, with a gloomy and sordid history of fierce electoral disputes and violence, is scheduled to hold general elections on Tuesday 9 August 2022. In these elections, citizens will elect the president, members of the National Assembly and Senate, county governors as well as members of the 47 county assemblies.

AI.tldr: 肯尼亚2022年大选：77岁资深反对派政治家奥廷加对阵55岁副总统鲁托，选举背景充满争议和暴力历史
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚2022年大选中的政治竞争如何影响选举结果和民主进程？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚选举历史充满争议和暴力，研究此次选举有助于理解政治竞争、民主稳定和选举暴力预防
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举政治理论、民主转型理论、政治暴力理论、代际政治竞争理论
AI.method: 基于新闻报道和选举数据的案例分析，结合历史比较分析
AI.findings: 肯尼亚选举面临代际政治竞争（77岁vs55岁）、历史遗留的选举争议问题，选举结果可能影响国家政治稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对发展中国家选举政治的理解，特别是选举暴力预防机制和代际政治竞争模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚选举观察提供分析框架，为国际社会理解非洲民主进程提供参考，为选举安全措施提供建议

title: Controlled Irrationality Index (CII): Rationality as an Activation Event
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Controlled Irrationality Index (CII): Rationality as an Activation Event
detail.abstract: Human cognition operates primarily through automatic, affect-guided routines. Rationality emerges only when these routines are interrupted and reconfigured. Building on the Controlled Irrationality (CI) framework, this paper defines rationality as an activation event-a transient act of control rather than a continuous faculty. The Controlled Irrationality Index (CII) formalizes this principle as a measurable frequency of pause-andrevision cycles in behavioral data such as Wikipedia and GitHub logs. By extending the same activation logic to human-AI systems, the paper completes the CI→CII bridge, showing that rationality is enacted, not possessed.

AI.tldr: 该论文将理性重新定义为一种激活事件而非持续能力，提出控制非理性指数(CII)来测量行为数据中的暂停-修正周期频率，并将此逻辑扩展到人机系统。
AI.research_question: 理性如何被概念化和测量？人类认知中的理性是如何出现的？如何将理性概念扩展到人机系统？
AI.motivation: 传统上理性被视为持续的能力，但作者认为这不符合人类认知的实际运作方式。人类认知主要通过自动的、情感引导的常规运作，理性只在常规被打断和重新配置时出现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制非理性(CI)框架，将理性定义为激活事件而非持续能力。理性是短暂的、瞬时的控制行为。
AI.method: 提出控制非理性指数(CII)，将其形式化为行为数据中暂停-修正周期的可测量频率。使用维基百科和GitHub日志等行为数据进行测量。
AI.findings: 理性可以被量化为行为数据中的暂停-修正周期频率。通过将相同的激活逻辑扩展到人机系统，完成了CI→CII的桥梁，表明理性是被执行的而非拥有的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新概念化理性为激活事件而非持续能力；2. 提出控制非理性指数(CII)作为理性的可操作化测量；3. 将理性概念扩展到人机系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供测量理性的实用工具(CII)；2. 可用于分析维基百科、GitHub等平台的行为数据；3. 为人机系统设计提供理论指导。

title: Institutions Eat Infrastructure for Lunch: A Complexity View of Africa’s Development Challenge
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Institutions Eat Infrastructure for Lunch: A Complexity View of Africa’s Development Challenge
detail.abstract: Africa's infrastructure crisis is institutional. The continent continues to build physical assets but neglects the institutions-the norms and values-that give those assets life. Roads and power plants fail not because of design flaws or lack of finance but because the societies around them do not sustain the habits of maintenance, accountability, and trust. This essay shows that infrastructure is not a collection of projects but an operator that depends on coherence between physical systems and social expectations. When norms and values drift apart from the rules meant to express them, management fails, and decay begins. Drawing on the frameworks of Layered Operator Appraisal and Four Worlds, the essay explains how Africa can stabilise this relationship through institutions that learn and adapt. The argument concludes that sustainable infrastructure will emerge only when domestic money thinks-when finance grows from cultural trust and engages global capital from a position of internal strength.

AI.tldr: 非洲基础设施危机本质上是制度危机，根源在于社会规范与物理资产之间的脱节，而非资金或设计问题。可持续基础设施需要建立能够学习和适应的制度，让国内资本基于文化信任发展，从而以内部实力与全球资本对接。
AI.research_question: 为什么非洲的基础设施（如道路、发电厂）经常失败？如何建立可持续的基础设施系统？
AI.motivation: 非洲持续建设物理资产但忽视支撑这些资产的制度（规范和价值），导致基础设施失败。问题不在于设计缺陷或资金缺乏，而在于社会缺乏维护、问责和信任的习惯。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层操作评估框架和四世界框架，强调基础设施作为操作者的概念，依赖于物理系统与社会期望之间的协调。
AI.method: 理论分析论文，基于制度理论和基础设施研究框架进行概念分析。
AI.findings: 基础设施失败是因为规范和价值与旨在表达它们的规则发生偏离，导致管理失败和衰败开始。可持续基础设施需要能够学习和适应的制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基础设施不仅是项目集合，更是依赖于物理系统与社会期望协调的操作者。强调制度在基础设施可持续性中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲基础设施发展提供路径：通过建立学习和适应的制度来稳定物理系统与社会规范的关系，让国内资本基于文化信任发展，从而以内部实力与全球资本对接。

title: Between State and Society - Honour, Law, and the Limits of Female Autonomy

detail.title: Between State and Society - Honour, Law, and the Limits of Female Autonomy

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval for this study was obtained from the Tokyo International University Ethics Committee, School of International Relations. All participants provided informed consent prior to data collection.

detail.abstract: Beneath the scaffolding of the Indian democracy lies an underbelly thick with contradiction, stitched together with violence, erasure, and the theatre of moral panic. At its core, a conflict exists between democracy and the continued marginalization of certain groups, where narratives within the general public incite fear and silence dissent. This research examines how these contradictions are perpetuated through the manipulation of identity politics, gender dynamics, and communal concerns via media, politics, and policy debates. This is primarily done by discussing in detail state backed narratives from the Partition to the present, particularly the violence and subjugation experienced by women during the partition era and the lived experiences of women victimized under the guise of the phantasmic concept of Love Jihad. Utilising a qualitative analysis of the ideological content of prevailing media and political discourse, the paper examines the mechanisms by which stereotypes and moral panics obscure women’s agency and dissenting communities get marginalized, thereby undermining democracy and concealing the inequality that is built into it. The results demonstrate compelling evidence that the patterns are rooted within the democratic framework, thus indicating that a paradox exists: any form of exclusion coexists with various voices of inclusiveness. The work invites a critical reflection on power, agency, and justice in contemporary India, exposing the complex realities beneath its democratic facade.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨印度民主框架下的矛盾现象，揭示国家支持的叙事如何通过身份政治、性别动态和媒体操纵来延续暴力、边缘化特定群体，并掩盖结构性不平等。
AI.research_question: 印度民主框架下，国家支持的叙事如何通过身份政治、性别动态和媒体操纵来延续暴力、边缘化特定群体，并掩盖结构性不平等？
AI.motivation: 印度民主表面下的深层矛盾：暴力、抹除和道德恐慌如何与民主理想共存，特别是针对妇女和边缘群体的系统性压迫。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份政治理论、性别研究、道德恐慌理论、后殖民理论、民主悖论理论。
AI.method: 对媒体和政治话语的意识形态内容进行定性分析，特别关注从印巴分治到"爱情圣战"概念的历史叙事。
AI.findings: 研究发现排斥模式根植于民主框架本身，形成了民主与排斥并存的悖论；刻板印象和道德恐慌掩盖了妇女的能动性，边缘化了异议社群。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了民主框架内排斥机制的运作方式，提出了"民主悖论"概念，扩展了后殖民民主理论中对权力、能动性和正义的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代印度社会矛盾提供批判性视角，揭示媒体和政治话语如何掩盖不平等，促进对民主实践中权力关系的反思。

title: Sovereign Priority Shares (SPS): A Hybrid Productive-Reserve Framework for Central Bank Currency Backing
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Sovereign Priority Shares (SPS): A Hybrid Productive-Reserve Framework for Central Bank Currency Backing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am independent researcher who has connection with anyone whatsoever

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Sovereign Priority Shares (SPS)a new reserve-grade equity instrument designed exclusively for central banks. SPS combine the productivity of corporate equity with the safety of senior liquidation priority and the neutrality of zero governance rights. By granting central banks full dividend parity, first-priority claims in insolvency, and unrestricted secondary-market tradability, SPS offer a modern alternative to traditional reserve assets such as gold. Using a comparative case study (2012-2025), the paper shows that SPS-backed reserves would have appreciated 8-9×, compared to gold's 5×, while also generating substantial dividend income. This demonstrates the significant opportunity cost of maintaining large non-productive gold positions. SPS align reserve strength with national productive capacity, improve long-term monetary stability, reduce reliance on commodity imports, and create a sustainable channel for innovation-oriented fiscal spillovers. The framework outlines the legal, regulatory, and operational architecture required for SPS adoption, including Companies Act amendments, IBC priority rules, SEBI protocols, and central-bank reserve classification. Stress tests show that SPS function as a productive third pillar-complementing, not replacing, FX reserves and gold. For emerging economies seeking stronger monetary resilience and growth-linked reserves, SPS provide a viable, scalable, and forward-looking evolution of reserve management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种专为央行设计的新型储备级股权工具——主权优先股(SPS)，它将企业股权的生产力与优先清算权的安全性以及零治理权的中立性相结合，为央行提供了一种替代传统黄金储备的现代选择。
AI.research_question: 如何为央行设计一种既能提供生产力回报又具有安全性的新型储备资产，以替代传统的非生产性黄金储备？
AI.motivation: 传统黄金储备存在机会成本高、非生产性等问题，央行需要一种既能保持储备安全性又能获得生产力回报的新型储备工具，以增强货币稳定性和经济增长联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于储备管理理论、股权工具设计理论和央行资产配置理论，结合优先股结构、清算优先级和治理权中立性等概念。
AI.method: 采用比较案例研究法（2012-2025年），分析SPS与黄金储备的表现差异，并进行压力测试评估SPS作为储备资产的功能。
AI.findings: SPS支持的储备在2012-2025年间增值8-9倍，而黄金仅增值5倍，同时SPS还能产生可观的股息收入，显示出维持大量非生产性黄金储备的显著机会成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了主权优先股(SPS)这一新型储备资产理论框架，将储备强度与国家生产能力相结合，为储备管理理论提供了创新性发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体提供了可行的、可扩展的储备管理方案，包括法律、监管和操作架构的具体设计，如公司法修订、破产法优先规则、SEBI协议和央行储备分类等。

title: Inflation Narratives and Expectations

detail.title: Inflation Narratives and Expectations

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: I study how demand-supply narrative disagreement between general and specialized newspapers can explain households’ absolute gap in inflation expectations with experts. I measure inflation narratives via a Causality Extraction algorithm that can identify causal relationships between events in a text and, hence, extract the perceived triggers of inflation. Causal relations can explain why narratives affect people’s beliefs and cannot be captured by dictionary methods, topic models, and word embeddings. I then classify inflation narratives into demand and supply narratives based on their focus on demand and supply triggers. I measure narrative disagreement between general and specialized newspapers from their attention difference on demand and supply narratives. The absolute expectation gap widens when narrative disagreement increases, especially for non-college-educated and older households. Unlike the narratives of specialized newspapers, the narratives of general newspapers incorrectly align with experts’ demand-supply views.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一般报纸和专业报纸在需求-供给叙事上的分歧如何解释家庭与专家通胀预期之间的绝对差距。通过因果提取算法识别通胀叙事中的因果关系，并将其分类为需求和供给叙事。研究发现，叙事分歧越大，预期差距越宽，尤其对非大学教育和年长家庭影响更大。
AI.research_question: 一般报纸和专业报纸在需求-供给通胀叙事上的分歧如何解释家庭与专家通胀预期之间的绝对差距？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭与专家通胀预期差异的来源对于政策制定至关重要。现有研究多关注定量因素，但对叙事传播机制的理解不足，特别是不同媒体类型在塑造通胀认知方面的作用差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于叙事经济学和媒体效应理论，强调叙事在塑造经济预期中的作用。区分需求驱动和供给驱动的通胀叙事，并关注不同媒体类型（一般vs专业）在传播这些叙事时的差异。
AI.method: 使用因果提取算法识别文本中的因果关系，从而提取通胀的感知触发因素。将通胀叙事分类为需求和供给叙事，测量一般报纸和专业报纸在关注需求与供给叙事上的差异作为叙事分歧指标。
AI.findings: 1. 叙事分歧增加会扩大绝对预期差距；2. 这种效应在非大学教育和年长家庭中更明显；3. 一般报纸的叙事与专家的需求-供给观点错误地保持一致，而专业报纸的叙事则更准确。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出使用因果提取算法分析经济叙事的新方法；2. 将需求-供给框架应用于叙事分析；3. 揭示不同媒体类型在传播经济信息中的差异化作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供理解通胀预期形成的新视角；2. 帮助识别最易受媒体叙事影响的群体；3. 为媒体监管和公众教育提供依据，以减少信息误解。

title: Global or Regional Safe Assets: Evidence from Bond Substitution Patterns
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department

detail.title: Global or Regional Safe Assets: Evidence from Bond Substitution Patterns

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper provides novel empirical evidence on portfolio rebalancing in international bond markets through the prism of investors’ demand for bonds. Using a granular dataset of global government and corporate bond holdings by mutual funds domiciled in the world’s two largest currency areas, I estimate heterogeneous and time varying demand elasticities for bonds. Safe assets such as US Treasuries or German Bunds face especially inelastic demand from investment funds compared to riskier bonds. But spillovers from these safe assets to global bond markets are strikingly different. Funds substitute US Treasuries with global bonds, including risky corporate and emerging market bonds, whereas German Bunds are primarily substitutable within a narrow set of euro area safe government bonds. Substitutability deteriorates in times of stress, impairing the transmission of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析全球两大货币区共同基金的债券持仓数据，发现安全资产（如美国国债、德国国债）需求弹性较低，但两者对全球债券市场的溢出效应不同：美国国债与全球各类债券（包括风险较高的公司债和新兴市场债券）存在替代关系，而德国国债主要在欧元区安全政府债券范围内可替代。压力时期替代性会恶化，影响货币政策传导。
AI.research_question: 国际债券市场中投资者的投资组合再平衡行为如何？不同安全资产（如美国国债和德国国债）的需求弹性有何差异？这些安全资产对全球债券市场的溢出效应有何不同？
AI.motivation: 理解国际债券市场中投资者的投资组合再平衡行为对货币政策传导和金融稳定至关重要。现有研究对安全资产需求弹性及其对全球债券市场的溢出效应缺乏深入分析，特别是在不同货币区和压力时期的表现差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合再平衡理论、资产需求弹性理论、安全资产理论，以及货币政策传导机制理论，分析投资者在不同债券类别间的替代行为。
AI.method: 使用全球两大货币区（美元区和欧元区）共同基金的政府债券和公司债券持仓的细粒度数据集，估计异质性和时变的债券需求弹性。
AI.findings: 1. 安全资产（美国国债、德国国债）相比风险债券面临更缺乏弹性的需求；2. 美国国债与全球各类债券（包括风险公司债和新兴市场债券）存在替代关系；3. 德国国债主要在欧元区安全政府债券范围内可替代；4. 压力时期替代性恶化，影响货币政策传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了国际债券市场投资组合再平衡的新经验证据；2. 揭示了不同安全资产需求弹性的异质性；3. 阐明了不同货币区安全资产对全球债券市场溢出效应的差异机制；4. 拓展了压力时期资产替代性变化的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行货币政策制定提供参考，特别是跨国溢出效应；2. 帮助投资者理解不同债券类别的替代关系和风险分散策略；3. 为金融监管机构评估系统性风险提供依据；4. 对国际资本流动管理和金融稳定政策有指导意义。

title: The Dynamic Structural Disequilibrium Economy: A Holistic Model of Inequality, Value, and Systemic Convergence
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Dynamic Structural Disequilibrium Economy: A Holistic Model of Inequality, Value, and Systemic Convergence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest The author, Fernando Miranda Abaunza, is an independent researcher. This research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. The author received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors for this work
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research presented in this paper is purely theoretical and computational. It does not involve any human participants, human data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Dynamic Structural Disequilibrium Economy (DSSDE), a theoretical and computational framework that integrates macroeconomic disequilibrium, inequality endogeneity, and the dynamics of systemic convergence. Building on Keynesian, structuralist, and post-Keynesian traditions, the model formalizes how inequality, monetary asymmetries, and financialization interact to shape production, investment, and social stability.

Unlike traditional Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) models, the DSSDE framework assumes persistent disequilibria, endogenous adjustment, and non-linear feedbacks between capital accumulation, productivity, and distributive structures.

The paper develops a set of axioms, structural equations, and “golden rules” of convergence under conditions of dynamic imbalance. Simulations illustrate two distinct evolutionary paths: (1) a normal path, in which inequality rises and productivity stagnates; and (2) a steady-state path, where structural policies — progressive taxation, mission-driven investment, and dual interest-rate regimes — restore convergence between savings and investment.

Beyond its mathematical formulation, the paper also explores the political-economy and existential implications of the current order: the erosion of dignity, the loneliness crisis, and the reduction of human value to capital ownership. The DSSDE thus serves as both a macroeconomic model and a moral critique of late capitalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了动态结构非均衡经济（DSSDE）框架，整合了宏观经济非均衡、不平等内生性和系统性收敛动态，挑战传统DSGE模型，展示了不平等、货币不对称和金融化如何影响生产、投资和社会稳定。
AI.research_question: 不平等、货币不对称和金融化如何相互作用塑造生产、投资和社会稳定？在动态失衡条件下，经济系统如何实现收敛？
AI.motivation: 传统DSGE模型假设均衡和理性预期，无法解释现实中的持续非均衡、不平等内生性和非线性反馈机制，需要新的理论框架来理解当代资本主义的结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于凯恩斯主义、结构主义和后凯恩斯主义传统，整合宏观经济非均衡理论、不平等内生性理论和系统性收敛动态理论。
AI.method: 建立理论框架（公理、结构方程和收敛"黄金法则"），并进行数值模拟分析两种演化路径：正常路径和稳态路径。
AI.findings: 模拟显示两种演化路径：1）正常路径：不平等加剧，生产率停滞；2）稳态路径：通过累进税制、使命驱动投资和双利率制度等结构性政策，恢复储蓄与投资的收敛。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出DSSDE框架挑战传统DSGE模型；2）形式化不平等、货币不对称和金融化的相互作用机制；3）建立动态失衡条件下的收敛理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为结构性政策（累进税制、使命驱动投资、双利率制度）提供理论基础；2）揭示当前秩序的政治经济学和存在主义影响；3）为理解晚期资本主义提供宏观模型和道德批判。

title: On green reputation: Green commitment versus greenwashing
affiliations: IMUVa. Departamento Economía Aplicada, Universidad de Valladolid and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: On green reputation: Green commitment versus greenwashing
detail.abstract: The paper studies a Cournot differential game between a brown firm, which produces business as usual, and a green firm, which uses a greener production technology. The greater the green efficiency, the more costly the green production, but also the faster the accumulation of green reputation, particularly when the pollution stock is high. Reputation growth also responds to greenwashing, defined by green advertising. Reputation determines the size of a premium price. The green firm chooses the state-dependent optimal advertising and the once-and-for-all optimal green efficiency. Convergence is oscillating, especially when consumers’ trust in advertising is low. Untrustworthiness also fosters green efficiency, green reputation, and improves the environment. Interestingly, a mixed economy, composed of a green and a brown firm, does well in social welfare terms. Pollution is low, similar to a pure green economy, especially with low credibility. And the producers’ and consumers’ surpluses are close to their high levels in the pure brown economy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个古诺微分博弈，其中棕色企业采用常规生产方式，绿色企业采用更环保的生产技术。绿色效率越高，生产成本越高，但绿色声誉积累越快（尤其在污染存量高时）。声誉增长受绿色广告（即"漂绿"）影响，声誉决定溢价水平。绿色企业选择状态依赖的最优广告和一次性最优绿色效率。收敛过程呈振荡性（尤其在消费者对广告信任度低时）。不信任反而促进绿色效率、绿色声誉并改善环境。有趣的是，由绿色和棕色企业组成的混合经济在社会福利方面表现良好：污染水平接近纯绿色经济（尤其在可信度低时），而生产者和消费者剩余接近纯棕色经济的高水平。
AI.research_question: 在绿色企业与棕色企业的古诺微分博弈中，绿色企业如何选择最优的绿色效率和广告策略？这些策略如何影响绿色声誉积累、环境污染和社会福利？混合经济（绿色+棕色企业）在社会福利方面是否优于纯绿色或纯棕色经济？
AI.motivation: 随着环保意识增强，企业面临采用绿色技术的决策。绿色技术虽然成本更高，但能建立环保声誉并获得溢价。然而，企业可能通过"漂绿"（绿色广告）夸大环保表现。消费者对广告的信任度影响声誉积累效果。需要研究在动态博弈中，绿色企业如何权衡绿色效率、广告投入，以及这些决策对市场竞争、环境和社会福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 古诺微分博弈框架：分析绿色企业和棕色企业在动态环境中的竞争互动
2. 绿色声誉积累模型：声誉增长取决于绿色效率、污染存量和广告投入
3. 状态依赖最优控制：绿色企业选择最优广告策略（状态依赖）和绿色效率（一次性决策）
4. 社会福利分析：比较纯绿色经济、纯棕色经济和混合经济的社会福利表现
AI.method: 采用微分博弈方法，建立包含绿色企业和棕色企业的古诺竞争模型。模型包含：绿色效率选择（一次性决策）、状态依赖的广告策略、绿色声誉积累过程（受效率、污染存量和广告影响）、污染动态、市场需求函数（含声誉溢价）。通过最优控制理论求解均衡策略，分析收敛特性（振荡收敛），并进行社会福利比较分析。
AI.findings:
1. 收敛过程呈振荡性，尤其在消费者对广告信任度低时更明显
2. 消费者不信任广告反而促进绿色企业提高绿色效率、积累绿色声誉并改善环境
3. 混合经济（绿色+棕色企业）在社会福利方面表现最佳：污染水平接近纯绿色经济（可信度低时更明显），而生产者和消费者剩余接近纯棕色经济的高水平
4. 绿色企业的最优策略：选择状态依赖的广告投入和一次性确定的绿色效率水平
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将绿色声誉积累过程形式化，纳入绿色效率、污染存量和广告（漂绿）的综合影响
2. 在微分博弈框架中分析绿色企业的最优效率选择和广告策略
3. 揭示消费者信任度对均衡动态的调节作用，特别是低信任度导致振荡收敛
4. 提出混合经济在社会福利方面的优越性理论，为环境经济学提供新见解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为绿色企业提供决策指导：如何权衡绿色技术投资和广告投入
2. 政策启示：适度容忍"漂绿"可能激励企业提高实际绿色效率，但需要监管平衡
3. 支持混合经济结构：同时保留绿色和棕色企业可能实现社会福利最大化
4. 消费者教育：适度的怀疑态度可能促进企业真正改善环境表现

title: Informative Risk Measures in the Banking Industry: A Proposal based on the Magnitude-Propensity Approach
affiliations: Iason Ltd, University of Padova - Department of Mathematics, Iason Ltd. and Iason Ltd.

detail.title: Informative Risk Measures in the Banking Industry: A Proposal based on the Magnitude-Propensity Approach
detail.abstract: Despite decades of research in risk management, most of the literature has focused on scalar risk measures (like e.g. Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall). While such scalar measures provide compact and tractable summaries, they provide a poor informative value as they miss the intrinsic multivariate nature of risk. To contribute to a paradigmatic enhancement, and building on recent theoretical work by [Faugeras and Pagès, 2024], we propose a novel multivariate representation of risk that better reflects the structure of potential portfolio losses, while maintaining desirable properties of interpretability and analytical coherence. The proposed framework extends the classical frequency-severity approach and provides a more comprehensive characterization of extreme events. Several empirical applications based on real-world data demonstrate the feasibility, robustness and practical relevance of the methodology, suggesting its potential for both regulatory and managerial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多元风险表示方法，克服了传统标量风险度量（如VaR和ES）的局限性，能更好地反映投资组合损失的多维本质，同时保持可解释性和分析一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种多元风险表示框架，既能反映风险的多维本质，又保持可解释性和分析一致性？
AI.motivation: 传统风险度量（如VaR和ES）虽然紧凑易处理，但作为标量度量无法捕捉风险的多维本质，信息价值有限，需要范式性改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Faugeras和Pagès（2024）的理论工作，扩展经典的频率-严重性方法，提出多元风险表示框架。
AI.method: 提出新的多元风险表示方法，保持可解释性和分析一致性，并通过多个基于真实数据的实证应用验证。
AI.findings: 实证应用表明该方法具有可行性、稳健性和实际相关性，能更全面地描述极端事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了风险管理的范式性改进，提出了新的多元风险表示理论框架，扩展了经典频率-严重性方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法具有监管和管理应用潜力，为风险管理实践提供了更全面的工具，能更好地反映投资组合损失结构。

title: Youth Empowerment and Sustainability: Building Jordan's Football Ecosystem
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Youth Empowerment and Sustainability: Building Jordan's Football Ecosystem

declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author, with mentorship support from Professor Chuck Garcia (Columbia University).

detail.abstract: Jordan’s football ecosystem has long struggled with weak structures, limited funding, and an absence of youth development pathways. This research proposes a comprehensive national framework aimed at rebuilding the sport through a sustainable, youth-centered model. The foundation of the project is the creation of a National Schools League that establishes structured competition, inclusivity across all regions, and long-term pathways for player growth. Drawing inspiration from global examples, such as South Africa’s use of sport for national unity, the paper argues that football can become a platform for social cohesion and national pride in Jordan. It also incorporates environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles; emphasizing how responsible infrastructure and transparent management can lower costs, attract private investment, and create lasting impact. The mission is to demonstrate that sustainability in sports goes beyond infrastructure; it depends on empowering youth, building community identity, and creating a system that ensures growth for future generations.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个以青年为中心的综合国家框架，通过创建全国学校联赛来重建约旦足球生态系统，强调可持续性、社会凝聚力和ESG原则。
AI.research_question: 如何通过可持续的青年中心模式重建约旦足球生态系统？
AI.motivation: 约旦足球生态系统长期存在结构薄弱、资金有限、缺乏青年发展路径等问题，需要系统性重建。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴南非等国的体育促进国家团结案例，结合环境、社会和治理（ESG）原则，构建可持续体育发展理论框架。
AI.method: 提出综合性国家框架设计，包括创建全国学校联赛，建立结构化竞赛、区域包容性和长期球员成长路径。
AI.findings: 足球可作为社会凝聚和国家自豪感的平台；负责任的基建和透明管理能降低成本、吸引私人投资；可持续性超越基础设施，依赖青年赋权、社区认同和系统性建设。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了体育可持续发展理论，将ESG原则与青年发展、社会凝聚力相结合，为发展中国家体育生态系统重建提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为约旦提供可操作的国家足球重建框架；创建全国学校联赛模型；展示如何通过体育促进社会团结；为吸引投资和长期发展提供实践指南。

title: Bootstrap-based non-parametric approach for identifying risk factors in stroke recurrence
affiliations: Rey Juan Carlos University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and King Juan Carlos University

detail.title: Bootstrap-based non-parametric approach for identifying risk factors in stroke recurrence
detail.abstract: Background and Objectives: Stroke is one of the leading cause of death and disability worldwide, with important social and financial consequences. This paper analyses risk factors for stroke recurrence using data science techniques with age-matched subsampling. We applied bootstrap-based non-parametric tests to explore associations between recurrence and clinical diagnoses, lifestyle habits, stroke type (ischaemic/hemorrhagic), and demographic variables in a cohort of 12,272 stroke patients from Seville, Spain (2010–2016), with recurrence tracked over five years.Methods: Binary risk factors were assessed using conventional tests, Chi-square and Fisher, and two bootstrap-based tests, one for differences in proportions and another integrating conventional tests. Age bias was mitigated via bootstrap subsampling with aligned age distributions. Subgroup analyses were conducted by stroke type and sex.Results: Recurrence was more frequent in men and in ischaemic strokes. In both sexes, ischaemic stroke recurrence was associated with diabetes and occlusion/stenosis of extra/intracranial arteries. In men, additional associations included dyslipidemia, hypertension, peripheral arterial disease, and smoking. Most of these were also relevant in hemorrhagic stroke among men, except diabetes and smoking. No significant factors were identified for hemorrhagic stroke recurrence in women.Conclusions: Bootstrap-based tests reduce age-related bias and yield fewer but more robust associations than conventional methods. Unlike conventional tests, the bootstrap approach provides visual insights into sample variability and the strength and direction of associations between recurrence and risk factors. Its methodology is easily adaptable to different clinical scenarios, enabling integration into decision support systems tailored to specific population profiles.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用数据科学技术和年龄匹配子抽样分析卒中复发风险因素，通过基于bootstrap的非参数检验发现缺血性卒中复发与糖尿病、动脉狭窄相关，男性患者还有更多风险因素，而女性出血性卒中无显著风险因素。
AI.research_question: 卒中复发的风险因素有哪些？如何通过数据科学技术减少年龄偏倚来识别这些风险因素？
AI.motivation: 卒中是全球主要的死亡和残疾原因，具有重要的社会和财务后果。传统统计方法可能存在年龄偏倚问题，需要更稳健的方法来识别卒中复发的风险因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于bootstrap的非参数统计方法、年龄匹配子抽样技术、风险因素分析框架
AI.method: 使用西班牙塞维利亚12,272名卒中患者（2010-2016）的队列数据，追踪5年复发情况。采用传统检验（卡方、Fisher）和两种基于bootstrap的检验（比例差异检验和整合传统检验的方法），通过年龄匹配子抽样减少年龄偏倚，按卒中类型和性别进行亚组分析。
AI.findings: 1. 复发在男性和缺血性卒中中更常见；2. 两性缺血性卒中复发均与糖尿病、颅内外动脉闭塞/狭窄相关；3. 男性患者还涉及血脂异常、高血压、外周动脉疾病和吸烟；4. 男性出血性卒中也有类似风险因素（除糖尿病和吸烟外）；5. 女性出血性卒中无显著风险因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明了基于bootstrap的检验能有效减少年龄相关偏倚；2. 与传统方法相比，bootstrap方法产生更少但更稳健的关联；3. 提供了可视化样本变异性和关联强度方向的新方法；4. 为临床风险因素分析提供了更可靠的统计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 方法易于适应不同临床场景；2. 可集成到针对特定人群特征的决策支持系统中；3. 为卒中复发预防提供性别和卒中类型特异的风险因素识别；4. 帮助临床医生制定更精准的预防策略。

title: Disaster, Capital, and Neighborhood Change: Tract-Level Evidence on Post-María Gentrification in Puerto Rico
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Disaster, Capital, and Neighborhood Change: Tract-Level Evidence on Post-María Gentrification in Puerto Rico
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the period surrounding Hurricane María coincides with an acceleration of neighborhood-level gentrification-like change in Puerto Rico. Using a harmonized tract-level panel from the ACS/PRCS 5-year estimates (2012-2023), I construct a composite gentrification index capturing neighborhood socioeconomic upgrading from income, rent, housing value, residential mobility, and educational attainment, and define pre-event "gentrifiable" tracts as those with baseline median household income below 80% of their metropolitan-status group's median. Panel fixedeffects and interrupted time-series models treat 2017 as a potential structural break and compare pre-and post-2017 trajectories between gentrifiable and nongentrifiable tracts. The estimates suggest that gentrifiable tracts experienced relatively larger post-2017 increases in the index, income, rents, and housing values, driven primarily by a persistent acceleration in trends rather than a one-time jump, while gaps in educational attainment and residential mobility remained roughly stable. High-response tracts cluster in metropolitan and coastal municipios, especially around San Juan and other urban centers. Vulnerability models and an XGBoost classifier indicate that strong post-shock upgrading is more likely in tracts that combine low baseline incomes and rents with relatively higher educational attainment, lower poverty, and lower residential mobility, with rent and mobility emerging as especially important predictors, whereas flood-zone exposure is not strongly predictive once these factors are controlled. Overall, the findings are consistent with a view of post-disaster gentrification in Puerto Rico as selective and path-dependent, shaped by pre-existing socioeconomic conditions and place-specific opportunity structures, and they provide tract-level vulnerability measures that may help inform anti-displacement and recovery policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究飓风玛丽亚前后波多黎各社区级绅士化变化是否加速，发现低收入但教育程度较高、贫困率较低、流动性较低的社区在灾后更容易发生绅士化升级。
AI.research_question: 飓风玛丽亚期间及之后，波多黎各社区级绅士化变化是否加速？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害可能加速社区转型和绅士化过程，但波多黎各灾后绅士化的具体模式和驱动因素尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾后绅士化理论、选择性绅士化、路径依赖理论、机会结构理论
AI.method: 使用ACS/PRCS五年估计数据（2012-2023）构建社区级面板数据，创建综合绅士化指数（收入、租金、房价、居住流动性和教育程度），采用面板固定效应和中断时间序列模型，以2017年为潜在结构断点，比较可绅士化与非绅士化社区的趋势变化。
AI.findings: 可绅士化社区在2017年后经历了相对更大的指数增长、收入增加、租金和房价上涨，主要由趋势持续加速而非一次性跳跃驱动；高响应社区集中在都市和沿海地区，特别是圣胡安等城市中心；灾后升级更可能发生在基线收入和租金较低但教育程度较高、贫困率较低、流动性较低的社区，租金和流动性是特别重要的预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持波多黎各灾后绅士化是选择性和路径依赖的观点，由现有社会经济条件和地方特定机会结构塑造；深化了对灾后社区转型机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供社区级脆弱性测量工具，可为反驱逐和恢复政策提供信息；识别易受灾后绅士化影响的社区特征，有助于针对性政策干预。

title: Identifying Government Spending Shocks through Disaggregated Public Expenditures

detail.title: Identifying Government Spending Shocks through Disaggregated Public Expenditures
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of increases in disaggregated components of public spending on economic activity in the United States. The decomposition of government purchases allows to identify the structural spending shocks, which are exogenous, not anticipated, and orthogonal We estimate their impulse responses through SVAR and local projection models, and compute their cumulative multipliers. Deficit-financed shocks to government employment turn out to be more expansionary than shocks to intermediate consumption and investment, with a multiplier above the unity. Results are robust to different data sources, time samples, specifications, and methodologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了美国公共支出各细分组成部分增加对经济活动的影响，发现政府就业的赤字融资冲击比中间消费和投资冲击更具扩张性，乘数大于1。
AI.research_question: 公共支出的不同细分组成部分（政府就业、中间消费、投资）的增加如何影响美国的经济活动？
AI.motivation: 理解政府支出的不同组成部分对经济的影响差异，为财政政策制定提供更精准的依据，特别是在赤字融资背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政政策乘数理论，结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，局部投影方法，政府支出分解理论。
AI.method: 使用SVAR和局部投影模型估计脉冲响应，计算累积乘数，通过分解政府购买来识别外生、未预期且正交的结构性支出冲击。
AI.findings: 赤字融资的政府就业冲击比中间消费和投资冲击更具扩张性，乘数大于1；结果在不同数据源、时间样本、模型设定和方法论下均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了政府支出细分组成部分对经济影响差异的实证证据，完善了财政乘数理论，特别是关于政府就业支出的扩张效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对性建议：在需要刺激经济时，增加政府就业支出可能比增加中间消费或投资支出更有效。

title: Deep Decarbonization Ambition and Equity: A Case Study of the Steel Sector in India in the Context of the EU's CBAM and Other International Developments
affiliations: Institute of Management Technology, Ghaziabad and Indian Institute of Management

detail.title: Deep Decarbonization Ambition and Equity: A Case Study of the Steel Sector in India in the Context of the EU's CBAM and Other International Developments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

declarations.funderStatement: Remaking Trade Project

detail.abstract: The European Union has recently proposed a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) as a means to tackle the risk of carbon leakage in the context of the EU Green Deal, The EU's CBAM aims at equalizing the carbon price paid by domestic EU producers in certain emissions intensive and trade exposed (EITE) sectors, such as steel, cement, aluminium, among others under the EU Emissions Trading Scheme (EU-ETS) and the carbon price "effectively" paid by the corresponding imported goods. The EU's CBAM has triggered strong criticisms by key trade partners of the EU including developing countries on multiple counts which include its unilateral nature, alleged green protectionism, inadequate environmental effectiveness, questionable trade law compatibility, and violation of the principles of climate justice and equity. These reactions have triggered geopolitical and trade tensions. Questions have also been raised regarding the efficacy of CBAM as an instrument in advancing deep decarbonization and just transition in the covered IETE sectors in the Global South. However, the EU CBAM is not alone. Unilateral BCAs are contemplated in various other jurisdictions also including UK, Canada and the US, each of which is in different stages of fruition, with each having its own underlying context, objective and design principles in view. Besides, other forms of green industrial policies with protectionist ramifications are emerging. All these exacerbates the risk of creating fragmentation in the global economy, which runs the risk of vitiating the environment for enhanced climate action which demands concerted global efforts. The question that arises is what role could trade regime play in facilitating enhanced climate action and deep decarbonization in the global South, while at the same time ensuring a global order that is fair, equitable and commensurate with the principles of climate justice. In particular, can a CBAM like measure be designed in such a way that it incentivizes deep decarbonization as well as just transition in the Global South? What role could climate clubs potentially play in this context? This paper explores these questions by considering a hard-to-abate CBAM-covered sector namely steel in a developing country like India as a case in point. It identifies the key drivers, barriers and potential enablers to deep decarbonization in the sector and analyses how the low carbon transition could happen in a just and fair manner. The paper then analyses the role that the trade system could play in that context.

AI.tldr: 欧盟碳边境调节机制(CBAM)引发贸易紧张，本文探讨贸易体系如何促进全球南方深度脱碳和公正转型，以印度钢铁业为案例。
AI.research_question: 贸易体系如何在促进全球南方深度脱碳和公正转型的同时，确保公平、公正且符合气候正义原则的全球秩序？CBAM类措施能否设计成激励全球南方深度脱碳和公正转型？气候俱乐部在此背景下能发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 欧盟CBAM引发贸易伙伴强烈批评，包括其单边性、绿色保护主义嫌疑、环境有效性不足、贸易法兼容性问题以及违反气候正义原则。这些反应加剧了地缘政治和贸易紧张，同时全球其他司法管辖区也在考虑类似单边措施，加剧全球经济碎片化风险，可能破坏需要全球协同努力的气候行动环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳泄漏理论、气候正义原则、贸易与环境关系理论、全球治理理论、公正转型理论、气候俱乐部理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以印度钢铁行业为案例，分析深度脱碳的关键驱动因素、障碍和潜在推动因素，探讨低碳转型如何以公正公平的方式实现。
AI.findings: 论文将识别钢铁行业深度脱碳的关键驱动因素、障碍和潜在推动因素，分析低碳转型如何以公正公平的方式实现，并探讨贸易体系在此背景下的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易与气候政策交叉领域提供理论框架，深化对CBAM类措施在促进全球南方公正转型中作用的理解，拓展气候俱乐部理论在实践中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计既能促进深度脱碳又能确保公正转型的CBAM类措施提供实践指导，为印度等发展中国家钢铁行业低碳转型提供政策建议，为国际气候谈判和贸易协定制定提供参考。

title: Rethinking Disclosure and the Cost of Capital
affiliations: Stanford University Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Rethinking Disclosure and the Cost of Capital
detail.abstract: This paper consolidates and extends ideas from the literature on disclosure quality and the cost of capital, showing that key puzzles remain unresolved. Although many studies examine whether firm-specific disclosures reduce firms' costs of capital, canonical models predict no such effect, consistent with the evidence that idiosyncratic risk fails to command a premium. While macroeconomic news in firm disclosures can affect the cost of capital in many disclosure models, this holds only because they treat the risk-free rate as exogenous. Even when these models are augmented to allow investors to explicitly prefer the early resolution of uncertainty, disclosure's effect on firms' costs of capital remains ambiguous. Finally, while widely studied empirically, a disclosure's impact on expected future returns can differ from its impact on the cost of capital, which can be more accurately assessed using average returns around its release. These returns suggest that firm-specific disclosures do, in fact, reduce firms' costs of capital.

AI.tldr: 本文整合并扩展了信息披露质量与资本成本相关文献，指出关键谜题仍未解决。虽然许多研究探讨公司特定披露是否降低资本成本，但经典模型预测无此效应，这与异质性风险不要求溢价的经验证据一致。尽管宏观新闻在披露模型中可影响资本成本，但这仅因模型将无风险利率视为外生变量。即使引入投资者偏好早期不确定性解决，披露对资本成本的影响仍不明确。实证研究发现，披露对预期未来回报的影响不同于对资本成本的影响，后者可通过披露发布期间的平均回报更准确评估，结果显示公司特定披露确实降低资本成本。
AI.research_question: 公司特定信息披露是否以及如何影响企业的资本成本？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中关于信息披露质量与资本成本关系存在关键谜题：经典理论模型预测公司特定披露不影响资本成本，但许多实证研究试图证明这种影响。需要澄清理论与实证之间的矛盾，并解决模型设定中的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价模型（CAPM）、信息披露理论、异质性风险定价理论、不确定性解决时间偏好理论
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，整合现有披露质量与资本成本文献，扩展理论模型，分析模型假设限制，并基于实证证据（披露发布期间的平均回报）进行验证
AI.findings: 1. 经典模型预测公司特定披露不影响资本成本，与异质性风险不要求溢价的经验证据一致；2. 宏观新闻在披露模型中影响资本成本仅因模型将无风险利率视为外生；3. 即使考虑投资者偏好早期不确定性解决，披露对资本成本的影响仍不明确；4. 披露对预期未来回报的影响不同于对资本成本的影响；5. 使用披露发布期间的平均回报评估显示，公司特定披露确实降低资本成本
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了信息披露与资本成本关系的理论谜题；2. 指出现有模型将无风险利率视为外生的局限性；3. 扩展了考虑不确定性解决时间偏好的理论框架；4. 区分了披露对预期回报与资本成本的不同影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实务界提供了更准确的资本成本评估方法（使用披露发布期间的平均回报）；2. 证实了公司特定披露确实能降低资本成本，支持企业加强信息披露实践；3. 帮助投资者更好理解披露信息对资本成本的实际影响

title: Domestic Demand as Industrial Strategy: China's 2025 Consumer Goods Trade-in Policy, with Policy Implications for South Korea
affiliations: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade

detail.title: Domestic Demand as Industrial Strategy: China's 2025 Consumer Goods Trade-in Policy, with Policy Implications for South Korea

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 25/IER/30/5/05
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIET Industrial Economic Review Vol. 30, No. 5

detail.abstract:
At the Central Economic Work Conference held in December 2024, the Chinese leadership identified the expansion of domestic demand as the top economic policy priority for 2025. For the first time, it mentioned the expanded and reinforced Two New (大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新, lit. Large-Scale Equipment Renewal and Consumer Goods Trade-in) policy.

The Two New policy appropriately has dual aspects, corresponding to production/investment and consumption: large-scale equipment renewal (production/investment) and consumer goods trade-in (以旧换新, lit. the replacement of old products with new ones), which represents the demand (consumption) side. First, large scale equipment renewal is a measure designed to encourage firms to replace or upgrade their facilities with equipment that is more technologically advanced, energy-efficient, and safe.

This is supported through investment subsidies, interest subsidies on loans, and other mechanisms, with the aim of enhancing productivity by expanding investment in more efficient manufacturing infrastructure. Second, the consumer goods trade-in policy is meant to stimulate consumption by providing subsidies to individual consumers who purchase consumer goods that meet government-designated standards. This measure seeks to unlock consumption potential and promote household spending.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了中国2025年经济政策重点——扩大内需，特别是"大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新"（"两新"政策）。该政策具有双重维度：生产/投资侧的大规模设备更新和消费侧的消费品以旧换新，旨在通过投资补贴和消费补贴分别刺激企业投资和家庭消费。
AI.research_question: "两新"政策（大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新）如何有效促进中国内需扩大？该政策的双重维度（生产/投资与消费）如何协同作用以实现经济增长目标？
AI.motivation: 2024年12月中央经济工作会议将扩大内需确定为2025年首要经济政策重点，首次提出"大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新"政策。中国面临内需不足、经济增长放缓的挑战，需要通过结构性政策同时刺激投资和消费。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于凯恩斯主义需求管理理论，结合供给侧结构性改革理论。设备更新对应投资乘数效应，消费品以旧换新对应消费函数理论。同时涉及产业升级理论、绿色经济理论和消费刺激政策理论。
AI.method: 政策分析框架，结合文献综述和理论分析。可能采用案例研究法分析政策设计，或使用计量经济学方法评估政策效果（如果论文包含实证部分）。
AI.findings: "两新"政策具有双重协同效应：设备更新通过投资补贴促进企业技术升级和生产率提升；消费品以旧换新通过消费补贴释放家庭消费潜力。政策设计体现了投资与消费的良性循环机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"投资-消费协同刺激"的政策框架，丰富了需求管理理论。将供给侧改革（设备更新）与需求侧管理（消费刺激）有机结合，为发展中国家经济政策设计提供新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的实施路径：设备更新通过投资补贴和利息补贴机制；消费品以旧换新通过政府标准制定和直接补贴。政策具有可操作性，能够同时促进产业升级和消费增长。

title: Who Bears the Burden of Climate Inaction?
affiliations: UCLA School of Law, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Energy and Environmental Policy Research (CEEPR) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Who Bears the Burden of Climate Inaction?

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Climate change is already increasing temperatures and raising the frequency of natural disasters in the United States. In this paper, we examine several major vectors through which climate change affects US households, including cost increases associated with home insurance claims and increased cooling, as well as sources of increased mortality. Although we consider only a subset of climate costs over recent decades, we find an aggregate annual cost averaging between $400 and $900 per household; in 10 percent of counties, costs exceed $1,300 per household. Costs vary significantly by geography, with the largest costs occurring in some western regions of the United States, the Gulf Coast, and Florida. Climate costs also typically disproportionately burden lower-income households. Our work suggests the importance of research that looks beyond rising temperatures to extreme weather events; so far, natural disasters account for the bulk of the burden of climate change in the United States.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了气候变化对美国家庭的经济影响，发现年均成本在400-900美元之间，部分地区超过1300美元，且低收入家庭负担更重。
AI.research_question: 气候变化通过哪些主要途径影响美国家庭经济负担？这些影响在不同地区和收入群体中如何分布？
AI.motivation: 气候变化已导致美国气温升高和自然灾害频发，但对其具体经济影响，特别是对家庭层面的综合成本缺乏系统量化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化经济学和环境经济学理论，分析气候变化的直接和间接成本传导机制。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，整合历史气候数据、保险索赔数据、能源消费数据和死亡率数据，量化气候变化的多维经济影响。
AI.findings: 1. 美国家庭年均气候成本400-900美元；2. 10%的县份成本超过1300美元；3. 西部、墨西哥湾沿岸和佛罗里达州受影响最大；4. 低收入家庭负担更重；5. 自然灾害是主要成本来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了气候变化家庭成本的多维评估框架；2. 揭示了气候成本的空间异质性和收入分配效应；3. 强调了极端天气事件在气候成本中的主导作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供气候适应和减缓的成本效益分析依据；2. 帮助识别气候脆弱区域和群体；3. 为保险定价和风险管理提供参考。
